items.html: However, since it was because of a sin, all these ten Sefirot descended below, into the Klipot, as written in the Etz Chaim. And she is at the final limit of diminution of them all; and then she gave birth to Cain and Hevel, through the coupling of ZON, as mentioned by us in the discourse on Cain and Hevel and the sin of the first man — see there how they were above at this hour.
